name: as_mut_unchecked
declaration: const unsafe fn as_mut_unchecked (& self) -> & mut T
rules: Calling `UnsafeCell::as_mut_unchecked` requires that no other references to the wrapped value are alive.
While the mutable reference returned by `UnsafeCell::as_mut_unchecked` is alive, the wrapped value must not be mutated through any other means.
